items.text: Purchasing animals now correctly deducts scrap.
Animal genetics now influence cow selling price.
Added new sheep traits for more varied behavior.
Introduced sea turtles with ocean‑style locomotion and proper population handling.
Fixed missing crate spawns in the "cave_small_Easy" map.
Bullets and arrows now correctly collide with oilrig scientists' upper bodies and register headshots only when appropriate.
Resolved double‑play of third‑person weapon sounds.
Helmet and diving mask audio muffling now persists correctly when downed, using its own low‑pass stage.
Heavy plate helmet and diving mask screen overlays no longer disappear when the player is downed or dead.
BBQ radial menu now correctly references the BBQ station instead of a campfire.
Fixed crate spawning inside the cave wall at the entrance of the small easy cave.
Locomotive bell sound is now broadcast to all players instead of being client‑side only.
Added construction sockets and relaxed building‑volume restrictions, making deployment of structures easier.
Lamb and sheep now drop Lamb Meat (cooked, raw, and spoiled). New model, textures, materials, prefabs, item names, descriptions, and icons were added.
New loot rooms added: Airfield, Harbor 1, and Harbor 2 power‑grid rooms.
Added an option to change the steering‑wheel code lock on player‑owned boats.
Enabled initiating NPC conversations over telephones.
Cows now heal only when their needs are met instead of while roaming, preventing trapped cows from healing indefinitely.
Harvesting cow, bull, and calf corpses now yields Raw Cow Meat, and the item’s name and description have been updated.
Stags now correctly respond to AI select and move commands.
Animal leads purchased from vendors now function correctly.
A new vendor has been added to the ranch, allowing players to buy and sell items directly at the ranch.
Refrigeration status now refreshes instantly when an item changes containers, eliminating previous delay.
Bullets and arrows now correctly hit Oil Rig scientists, and leg shots register proper headshots.
Crate outside the small easy cave now spawns correctly outside instead of inside the wall.
Locomotive bell sound is audible to all nearby players, not just the one who triggered it.
Building volume restrictions have been relaxed, making it easier to place construction sockets.
Livestock health and tethering improvements: cows only heal when their needs are met, animal leads no longer break after purchase, and sheep/lamb now yield Lamb Meat when harvested.
Stag AI now responds to select and move commands.
New cow meat items (raw, cooked, spoiled) added; corpses drop raw cow meat.
Players can now call NPCs via telephone to start phone conversations.
A new vendor NPC is available at the ranch for direct purchases.
Refrigeration status updates instantly when items change containers.
Steering wheel code lock on player boats can now be changed.
New loot rooms added at Airfield and Harbor 1, expanding loot locations.

2026-09-09.summary:
### Combat & Targeting
- Bullets and arrows now correctly hit Oil Rig scientists, and leg shots register proper headshots.

### World & Objects
- Crate outside the small easy cave now spawns correctly outside instead of inside the wall.
- Locomotive bell sound is audible to all nearby players, not just the one who triggered it.

### Building & Construction
- Building volume restrictions have been relaxed, making it easier to place construction sockets.

### Animals & Farming
- Livestock health and tethering improvements: cows only heal when their needs are met, animal leads no longer break after purchase, and sheep/lamb now yield Lamb Meat when harvested.
- Stag AI now responds to select and move commands.
- New cow meat items (raw, cooked, spoiled) added; corpses drop raw cow meat.

### NPCs & Interaction
- Players can now call NPCs via telephone to start phone conversations.
- A new vendor NPC is available at the ranch for direct purchases.

### Items, Crafting & New Content
- Refrigeration status updates instantly when items change containers.
- Steering wheel code lock on player boats can now be changed.
- New loot rooms added at Airfield and Harbor 1, expanding loot locations.

items.text: NPCs can now sell baby animals to players
Livestock can now drink water from troughs with integrated water container
Frogs can swim and more reliably locate water spots for croaking
Fixed livestock pathfinding in short corridors, preventing premature path completion
Sandbag pillbox barricade deployable added, with new sandbag variations and its own crafting and repair setup
Smart alarm can now be placed on top of more deployables and has corrected bounds
Gate improvements: reversed open direction, better volume snapping, updated collision bounds, fixed socket checks, and wood‑based debris protection for durability
Cooking workbench no longer stops in snow when refrigerated items are inserted, preserving the refrigerated flag on split stacks
Placeholder crafting costs adjusted to more sensible values
Ferry terminal loot room now functional with its own power grid
Fixed server stall caused by dtRaycast infinite loop and updated navigation version to avoid degenerate polygon saves
Honey bandage added to both primitive and hardcore tech trees

2026-09-08.summary:
### Animals & NPCs
- NPCs can now sell baby animals to players
- Livestock can now drink water from troughs with integrated water container
- Frogs can swim and more reliably locate water spots for croaking
- Fixed livestock pathfinding in short corridors, preventing premature path completion

### Structures & Defenses
- Sandbag pillbox barricade deployable added, with new sandbag variations and its own crafting and repair setup
- Smart alarm can now be placed on top of more deployables and has corrected bounds
- Gate improvements: reversed open direction, better volume snapping, updated collision bounds, fixed socket checks, and wood‑based debris protection for durability

### Crafting & Cooking
- Cooking workbench no longer stops in snow when refrigerated items are inserted, preserving the refrigerated flag on split stacks
- Placeholder crafting costs adjusted to more sensible values

### Power & Loot Rooms
- Ferry terminal loot room now functional with its own power grid

### Server Stability
- Fixed server stall caused by dtRaycast infinite loop and updated navigation version to avoid degenerate polygon saves

### Medical Items
- Honey bandage added to both primitive and hardcore tech trees

items.text: Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.
Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.
Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.
Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.
Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

2026-09-07.summary:
### Animals & Livestock
- Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
- Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.

### Weapons & Attachments
- Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
- Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.

### Building & UI
- Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.
